description: Actual sequential engine outcomes. Quick runs are preliminary; no success requirement imposed on funnel or mixture. Exact targets and quality-gated tests are reported separately.

definitions.reference: ArviZ 0.21.0 public rhat, ess and mcse functions; Vehtari et al. (2021)
definitions.shape: chain, draw, parameter; retained post-warmup draws including rejections
definitions.split: First and last floor(draws/2) draws; omit the middle draw when odd
definitions.rank_rhat: Split R-hat of pooled average ranks transformed by Phi^-1((rank-3/8)/(N+1/4))
definitions.folded_rhat: Rank-normalized split R-hat of absolute deviations from the pooled split median
definitions.ess_bulk: Geyer initial positive/monotone sequence ESS of rank-normalized split chains
definitions.ess_tail: Minimum split indicator ESS at pooled raw 5th and 95th percentiles
definitions.ess_mean: Geyer initial positive/monotone sequence ESS of raw-scale split chains
definitions.mcse_mean: Pooled raw sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(raw-scale ess_mean)
definitions.ess_bound: Integrated autocorrelation lower bound 1/log10(N); ESS may exceed N
definitions.unavailable: Nonfinite, any constant original chain, fewer than 2 chains or 4 draws
definitions.status: R-hat >1.01: chains disagree; ESS <100 per chain or <50 draws: preliminary; no convergence proof

diagnostics.message: R-hat and MCMC ESS do not apply to variational draws. Each fit is reported separately.
